simple.meaning: זוּל (zûwl) is a Hebrew action word meaning “probably to shake out, i.e. (by implication) to scatter profusely; figuratively, to treat lightly.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Isaiah, Lamentations, beginning at Isaiah 46:6. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זוּל (H2107) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זוּל (zûwl) / H2107 is traced through Isaiah 46:6, Lamentations 1:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: probably to shake out, i.e. (by implication) to scatter profusely; figuratively, to treat lightly
definitions.full: H2107. zul II. זוּל verb lavish (compare Aramaic זוּל , be cheap, of little value, lightly esteem ; similarly זלל q. v.) — Qal Participle מִכִּיס זָהָב הַזָּלִים Isa 46:6 (|| יִשְׁקֹ֑לוּ בַּקָּנֶה כֶּסֶף ).
